# Paths that the Markdown files link to but that do not exist in the Go repository yet (see
# linkcheck.py). Repository-relative; a trailing slash means everything under it. An entry applies
# only while its path does not exist; once it exists, the entry is stale and the check fails until
# the line is removed. crates/ and Cargo.toml are permanent: the unchanged Rust ADRs link to them
# and the Go repository never has them (so they never go stale). Every other entry is removed when
# the phase that creates the path lands.
